reference: By tonight the whole group will have watched that penalty on repeat.
sk: Do večera si tú penaltu pozrie celá skupina dokola.
cz: Do večera si tu penaltu pustí celá skupina dokola.
acceptable: By {tonight|this evening|the evening} the {whole|entire} group will have watched {that|the} penalty {on repeat|over and over|over and over again|again and again}.
The {whole|entire} group will have watched {that|the} penalty {on repeat|over and over|over and over again|again and again} by {tonight|this evening}.

mistakes.text: By {tonight|this evening} the whole group will watch that penalty on repeat.
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Do večera“ znamená, že dej bude vtedy hotový, preto Future Perfect: „will have watched“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Do večera“ znamená, že děj bude tehdy hotový, proto Future Perfect: „will have watched“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “By tonight” means finished before then, so use Future Perfect: “will have watched”.

mistakes.text: By {tonight|this evening} the whole group will have watch that penalty on repeat.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Future Perfect sa tvorí „will have“ + past participle: „will have watched“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Future Perfect se tvoří z „will have“ + past participle: „will have watched“.
mistakes.feedback_en: Future Perfect is “will have” + past participle: “will have watched”.

mistakes.text: Until {tonight|this evening} the whole group will have watched that penalty on repeat.
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Do večera“ ako termín je „by“; „until“ znamená „až do“ (dej trvá celý čas).
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Do večera“ jako termín je „by“; „until“ znamená „až do“ (děj trvá celou dobu).
mistakes.feedback_en: For a deadline use “by”; “until” means “all the time up to”.

mistakes.text: By {tonight|this evening} the whole group will be watching that penalty on repeat.
mistakes.kind: Future Continuous instead of Future Perfect
mistakes.feedback_sk: Future Continuous opisuje dej, ktorý bude večer prebiehať; hotový dej vyjadrí „will have watched“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Future Continuous popisuje děj, který bude večer probíhat; hotový děj vyjádří „will have watched“.
mistakes.feedback_en: Future Continuous means in progress then; finished by that time is “will have watched”.

source_issues: SK 'pozrie' (will watch) vs CZ 'pustí' (will play); meaning the same, 'watched' fits both.
